rule: Remove exact duplicate rows (all 8 columns identical)
note: Same invoice, product, quantity, price, timestamp -> treated as double entry

rule: Separate non-product lines (POST, DOT, M, D, S, B, C2, BANK CHARGES, AMAZONFEE, CRUK, PADS, gift vouchers)
note: Kept in non_product_lines file; excluded from merchandise revenue

rule: Separate cancellations (InvoiceNo starts with 'C') into returns table
note: Analysed separately as returns; netted off in net-revenue metrics

rule: Remove sales lines with Quantity <= 0 (stock write-offs / damages)
note: Non-customer stock adjustments, not real sales

rule: Remove sales lines with UnitPrice <= 0 (free items / adjustments)
note: Zero-priced lines carry no revenue and usually have no description

rule: Remove return lines with UnitPrice <= 0 or Quantity >= 0
note: Cannot value a return without a positive price

rule: Standardise product names (one canonical description per StockCode)
note: 212 StockCodes had >1 spelling; 6,894 rows renamed. Missing descriptions before: 0, after: 0

rule: Add derived columns: Revenue, InvoiceMonth, InvoiceDay, Weekday, Hour, HasCustomerID
note: Revenue = Quantity x UnitPrice (ReturnValue is positive for returns)

rule: Flag lines without CustomerID (kept for revenue/product analysis)
note: Excluded only from customer-level analysis (RFM, cohorts, repeat behaviour)
Returns table: 8,668 rows; non-product lines: 2,910 rows
